title: $69 billion and four new rules: how the RBI is defending the rupee
short: $69 billion and four new rules: how the RBI defends the rupee
dek: India's forex reserves have fallen from a record $785.71 billion to $717.06 billion in eight weeks. Where the money went, the curbs on dollar speculation, and whether it's working.
card: Reserves are down about $69 billion since September, and the rupee is back near ₹94. How the RBI's toolkit works.
